meta.source: Web research (Wikipedia, TED, Forbes, Social Blade, primary sources)
meta.note: Growth timelines for top experience creators. Behavior = what they did. Inflection = when growth happened. Triggers = which of the 5 remarkable triggers apply.

remarkable_triggers.unexpected_combination: Two things that don't belong together, together
remarkable_triggers.rule_broken: Did what the field says you shouldn't, and it worked
remarkable_triggers.impossible_result: Evidence that defies what people believe is possible
remarkable_triggers.stupid_simplicity: Answer so simple it feels insulting, and it works
